title: report_feedback's health-value check is narrower than the Sentry scrub for one input form; align the two
evidence: Owner ruled 2026-11-25: the check refuses what either rule finds, and the scrub is unchanged. unsafeFeedback (packages/health-core/src/mcp-feedback.ts) runs its own checks first, then firstScrubbedValue (packages/health-core/src/sentry-scrub.ts), the first match scrubText would redact as a value (US-32 AC9b). Gate test in packages/health-core/src/mcp-tools.test.ts: a seeded generator built from the feedback rule's operations (packages/health-core/src/__fixtures__/feedback-grammar.ts); every generated report the scrub redacts a value in is refused, and a frozen corpus of reports the check refused before is still refused.
